source_caption_text:
Four years ago today, the battle rap community lost one of its most recognizable and respected figures, #PatStay 🕊️❤️‍🩹

Pat was arguably one of the greatest battle rappers of all time. His charisma, wit, presence, and ability to entertain made him one of the most well-known names in battle rap — not just in Canada, but around the world.

But beyond the battles, the accolades, and the unforgettable moments, Pat was a person first.

He was a father, a partner, a friend, and a genuinely down-to-earth guy who meant a lot to the people around him. To his fans, he was a battle rap legend. To the people who knew and loved him personally, he was much more than that.

His life was tragically cut short in 2022, leaving behind family, friends, and an entire culture that continues to remember

countless artists and public figures shared their condolences and celebrated the impact Pat had on battle rap.

Four years later, his legacy continues to live on

PATSTAYFOREVER 🙏🏽
